'''Steel-tailed stalker''' was a predatory [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] [[Bogstalker]] that rapidly evolved on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]] after being transplanted there. The creature evolved a [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]]-like barb at the end of its tail, which Doctor [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] deemed enough to classify it as a new breed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Steel-tailed stalkers appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 12: Visions in the Dark'''.
